The statute will most likely be declared unconstitutional because the 7% signature requirement, combined with the short 180-day circulation period, imposes a severe burden on independent candidates' and political bodies' ballot access, violating First and Fourteenth Amendment rights of association and voting under Anderson v. Celebrezze. Such discriminatory ballot-access laws fail the balancing test when they unfairly entrench established parties.  
CONFIDENCE: 85
